novelty.justification: The bridge-inspired framing is now clearer and the bounded claim is more credible.

technical_depth.justification: The algorithmic view and config table help, but SWD is still described mostly verbally; the paper needs a precise empirical objective.

experimental_rigor.justification: Baseline completion status is now explicit. The paper still needs a stronger rationale for the custom artifact diagnostics and EC score.

evidence_presentation.justification: Main, artifact, and ablation tables are useful. Analysis should be more causal and less descriptive.

writing_clarity.justification: The narrative is clearer, but the title and method pitch can be sharper.

reproducibility.justification: The implementation table and path references improve reproducibility.

remaining_major_weaknesses: The SWD objective needs an explicit empirical formula over patch sets and projections.
The paper should explain why EC is used only as a diagnostic composite and not as a universal objective.
The SaMST artifact argument needs a metric taxonomy: raw style/content, perceptual quality, high-frequency realism, and ablation evidence.
The method still sounds somewhat generic unless the contribution is named and framed more sharply.
Resource/reproducibility details should be moved from path-heavy prose to a concise, readable form.
revision_plan: Rename title to emphasize terminal SWD and kinetic regularization.
Add formal SWD objective equations and define patch sets/projections.
Clarify EC as a paper-internal Pareto diagnostic, not a canonical metric.
Strengthen discussion of failure modes: StyleID semantic drift, SaMST grain, AdaIN washed structure.
Reduce path overfull issue by replacing long texttt paths with shorter labels.
